description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing organization webhooks, including endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting webhooks, with associated guards, decorators, and service calls.

classes.name: OrganizationsWebhooksController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling organization webhooks with endpoints for CRUD operations, protected by guards and decorators.

methods.name: getAllOrganizationWebhooks
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of webhooks for a specific organization.

methods.name: createOrganizationWebhook
methods.description: Creates a new webhook for the specified organization.

methods.name: getOrganizationWebhook
methods.description: Retrieves details of a specific webhook by ID.

methods.name: deleteWebhook
methods.description: Deletes a specific webhook by ID.

methods.name: updateOrgWebhook
methods.description: Updates an existing webhook by ID.
